title: We'll be back soon
description: The system is currently unavailable for maintenance. Please check back soon.

notices.title: Scheduled Maintenance
notices.message:
We will be performing scheduled maintenance on your LMS on **Sunday at 9:00 PM BST (UK time)**.

Your LMS may be temporarily unavailable during the maintenance window. Any courses in progress at the start of the maintenance may be interrupted, so we recommend completing any active sessions beforehand.

We apologise for any inconvenience and appreciate your patience while we carry out this maintenance.

We expect this maintenance window to last between 15-60 minutes.
